boundaryNote: The 194 neighbourhood boundaries published with Winnipeg's 2016 census values, joined by year and boundary code. These historical census polygons are retained when measuring newer municipal inventories.
coverageNote: City of Winnipeg only, not the Winnipeg CMA. Covers the 194 neighbourhoods in the 2016 census-boundary release; industrial, undeveloped and other areas absent from that release are not mapped. Separate 2021 profiles exist, but their boundary correspondence has not been verified. Census facts remain 2016; parks, facilities and bus stops carry their own dates. These inventories do not cover groceries, schools, clinics or all local amenities.

population.label: Population in private households
population.note: 2016 custom census profile age total for people in private households. Excludes collective-dwelling residents; 25% sample, rounded counts.
population.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

households.label: Private households
households.note: Private households by household size, 2016 custom census tabulation; rounded counts.
households.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

children.label: Children under 15
children.note: People aged 0–14 divided by population in private households; 2016 custom tabulation, rounded counts.
children.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

householdSize.label: Estimated people per household
householdSize.note: Persons in private households divided by private households by household size, rounded to one decimal. Calculated from rounded 2016 counts, not the publisher's average.
householdSize.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

livingAlone.label: One-person households
livingAlone.note: One-person households divided by private households by household size, 2016 custom census tabulation.
livingAlone.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

apartments.label: Homes in apartment buildings
apartments.note: Occupied private dwellings in apartment buildings with fewer than five or at least five storeys, divided by occupied dwellings by structural type. Duplexes excluded; rounded 2016 counts.
apartments.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

renters.label: Households renting
renters.note: Renter households divided by all private households by tenure; 2016 25% sample, rounded counts.
renters.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

tenantShelter.label: Median tenant shelter cost
tenantShelter.note: 2016 occupied rentals in non-farm, non-reserve private dwellings; includes utilities where applicable, all dwelling sizes, 25% sample. Not current asking rent. Zero/absent cost estimates or non-positive tenant denominators remain unavailable.
tenantShelter.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

transit.label: Commutes by public transit
transit.note: Public-transit commuters divided by employed people aged 15+ in private households with a usual workplace or no fixed workplace address; excludes home workers. 2016 25% sample; historical commuting, not present service.
transit.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

walkCycle.label: Commutes on foot or by bike
walkCycle.note: Walking plus cycling commuters over the same 2016 employed commuter denominator; excludes home workers, rounded 25% sample counts.
walkCycle.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

parkland.label: Mapped parks and open space
parkland.note: Share covered by the union of the city's park/open-space polygons; overlapping polygons counted once. Includes the inventory's open-space categories and any water within the polygons; not tree canopy or all green space.
parkland.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

parks.label: Park/open-space sites overlapping the area
parks.note: Distinct park IDs with more than 1 m² of polygon overlap. A site crossing boundaries can appear in more than one neighbourhood.
parks.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

busStops.label: Bus stops in or near the area
busStops.note: Distinct scheduled boarding stop IDs inside or within 800 m of the original polygon. Opposite-direction stops count separately. Straight-line distance to the area, not walking distance from a home, frequency, or rail service.
busStops.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

libraries.label: Mapped library sites in the area
libraries.note: Distinct library complex IDs whose published point lies inside or on the 2016 boundary. The inventory has no operational-status field; counts do not promise an open branch or opening hours.
libraries.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

communityCentres.label: Mapped community centres overlapping the area
communityCentres.note: Recreation complexes marked community_centre=true with more than 1 m² of overlap with the 2016 boundary; distinct name/address pairs. Not all civic facilities, and no assurance of opening hours.
communityCentres.geographicScope: City of Winnipeg neighbourhoods on the publisher's 2016 census boundaries; not the Winnipeg CMA.

sources.title: Census Boundaries
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Winnipeg. The City of Winnipeg does not endorse this product.
transformations: Select 2016 Neighbourhood records; keep the geometry supplied with that census release. Display-only simplification by 12 metres in EPSG:26914; WGS84 clockwise exteriors.
notes: Manually refreshed snapshot. Retrieval and catalogue update dates do not change the observation period.

sources.title: Census Values
sources.licence: Open Government Licence - Winnipeg; Statistics Canada Open Licence
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Winnipeg. Adapted from Statistics Canada, 2016 Census of Population, custom tabulation supplied to the City of Winnipeg. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
transformations: Join year=2016 and exact boundary_code to the publisher's census boundaries; retain sex=All. Validate characteristic labels and reject duplicate cells.
Derive shares from rounded counts. Estimate people per private household from persons in private households divided by households; do not use the API's integer-only average.
Do not interpret an absent/zero tenant shelter-cost estimate as a $0 rent.
notes: Manually refreshed snapshot. Retrieval and catalogue update dates do not change the observation period.

sources.title: Parks and Open Space
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Winnipeg. The City of Winnipeg does not endorse this product.
transformations: Union geometry by park_id; intersect original 2016 neighbourhoods in EPSG:26914. Count sites with more than 1 square metre of overlap; union overlapping sites for area share.
notes: Manually refreshed snapshot. Retrieval and catalogue update dates do not change the observation period.

sources.title: Library
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Winnipeg. The City of Winnipeg does not endorse this product.
transformations: Deduplicate complex_id and count mapped library points covered by original 2016 polygons. Inventory records do not certify current opening hours or operational status.
notes: Manually refreshed snapshot. Retrieval and catalogue update dates do not change the observation period.

sources.title: Recreation Complex
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Winnipeg. The City of Winnipeg does not endorse this product.
transformations: Deduplicate recreation complexes by name and address; attribute sites with more than 1 square metre of polygon overlap. The community-centre count includes only community_centre=true sites.
notes: Manually refreshed snapshot. Retrieval and catalogue update dates do not change the observation period.

sources.title: Winnipeg Transit GTFS schedule and bus stops
sources.licence: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and Licence (PDDL) v1.0; LICENCE included in the feed
sources.attribution: Winnipeg Transit GTFS data. The City does not endorse this product.
transformations: Keep distinct stop_id boarding stops referenced by bus-route trips (GTFS route_type 3). Opposite-direction stops remain distinct.
Measure straight-line distance from each point to each original 2016 neighbourhood polygon in EPSG:26914; include stops inside or within 800 m.
notes: Schedule inventory over the feed's full validity period; not real-time availability, frequency, walking distance, or a measure of daily service.
